title: Build your empire
intro: Launch your own crypto, take your company public or run your own mining pool. It's pricey, a moderator checks the name, and the rules stop anyone from raiding the till:

rules.locked: Liquidity locked forever in the pool: the creator can't rug pull.
rules.share: Your cut: {share} of the supply, paid out bit by bit over {days} days.
rules.royalties: Royalties: {share} of the fees paid by other players trading your asset.
rules.refund: Rejected = refunded in full, fees and deposit. Max {max} creations per type.

CRYPTO.label: A crypto
CRYPTO.pitch: Your very own meme, listed against everyone else's. If it catches on, your cut gains value and you earn royalties on every trade.

COMPANY.label: A company
COMPANY.pitch: Take your business public: quarterly earnings, dividends you set, takeovers… and bankruptcy if it all goes south.

POOL.label: A mining pool
POOL.pitch: Miners join you, you skim your fee off every reward. Get too greedy and they'll go elsewhere.
